items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: Frank Mills, he was the bass player... He played with this band too... I used to travel with a band... that was Frank Mills then.

ctx.x: Trombone, clarinet, trumpet, banjo, bass, violin. No, it's a fellow, he been dead for years too. Frank Mills, he was the bass player. You heard of him. Yeah, he was a real good bass player too. He played with this band too. And sometimes he would take sicken, so we would use chestisardis. Oh, yeah? Yeah, chestisardis. He was a player with this Joe Harris sometimes. And so we had a pretty good band then too. We were playing about four or five nights a week.
